v51.typography:
One family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (Braille Institute, SIL OFL 1.1). It is self-hosted as public/fonts/atkinson-latin.woff2 (preloaded) and atkinson-latin-ext.woff2. The files are variable 200-800, but @font-face declares 'font-weight: 400 700' and only two weights are used. 400 is for reading and UI text. 700 is for h1-h4, labels, nav, buttons, strong, list-row titles, standalone links, ledger figures, table heads and the wordmark. No italics are shipped. The GSUB table has tnum, so every ledger, table, input, stat, meta line and figure sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

Bricolage Grotesque leaves the pages: both @font-face rules in src/styles/fonts.css, the preload in BaseLayout.astro, --font-display, and public/fonts/bricolage-latin.woff2 and bricolage-latin-ext.woff2 are deleted. It survives only at build time: in scripts/fonts for the share images, until Rajvir approves an Atkinson TTF, and as the outline of the badge's B. Kalam is deleted with the hand notes.

Scale, from 360 to 1280:
- --text-xs 14px: fine print, source lines, licence, chart labels.
- --text-sm 16px: nav, crumb, meta, hints, captions, table text, footer, small buttons.
- --text-md 18-19px: body, labels, inputs, option rows, buttons, the 'In this lesson' rows on phones.
- --text-lg 20-24px: the lede (once per page), h3, poll legends, the key idea, list-row titles, ledger figures, the wordmark.
- --text-h2 24-32px: h2, ledger totals, dashboard values, the one-time code.
- --text-h1 32-44px: page titles, calculator headline figures, edition figures, the explorer figure, the dashboard clock.
- --text-display 36-52px: the home h1 only.

That is seven sizes, never more than three in one view. Reading text never drops below 18px and nothing drops below 14px.

Headings are --ink #0B1240 at 700 and never blue, even when a heading is a link. h1 and display use line-height 1.1 and tracking -0.01em. h2 and h3 use 1.2 and tracking 0. An h2 has 48px above and 16px below, with no hairline. All headings use text-wrap: balance.

Body uses line-height 1.5; UI and table cells use 1.35. A p has max-width 32em (about 70 characters) inside a 640px column, text-wrap: pretty, and margin 0 0 1em; an li has 0.5em. Sentence case everywhere, no letter-spacing on body, no ALL CAPS. The eyebrow stays as a small --text-sm 700 --muted text label, because the protected legal pages use it.

Hindi, later: Noto Sans Devanagari 400/700 at the same sizes, with the measure re-checked for that script.

Inside, .container.header-inner (position relative) is a grid.

DOM order: a.brand, nav.main-nav, details.nav-menu, then RegionTabs (nav.region-tabs).

Below 1024px the grid is one column with rows var(--bar-h), auto, auto:

- details.nav-menu[data-disclosure] sits in row 2. Its summary is absolutely positioned up into the bar: top 0, inset-inline-end 0, height var(--bar-h). - nav.region-tabs sits in row 3: a white row, min-height var(--edition-row-h), with the header's 1px --rule bottom border under it.
- nav.main-nav is display:none.

components.name: Buttons (.btn, .btn-secondary, .btn-sm, .btn-link, .btn-row)
components.spec:
.btn is the primary, at most one per screen. It has a --blue fill and a 2px --blue border (so its edge shows in forced colours), a white 700 label at --text-md, min-height var(--target-lg), padding 0 20px, --radius and line-height 1.2. Hover and active use --blue-dark for fill and border. Disabled is opacity .5 with a not-allowed cursor. It has no transform, transition, arrow box or shadow.

.btn-secondary is neutral, per decision 10: --bg fill, 2px --ink border, --ink 700 label, same size; hover gives a --surface fill. It is used for poll reveals (Poll.astro's summary class becomes 'btn btn-secondary'), Show me steps, Reset, Copy link, Share, Mark as read, Privacy choices, Add a line, and the banner's Reject all and Accept all.

.btn-sm has min-height var(--target), padding 0 16px and --text-sm.

.btn-link is a text button or link: no fill or border, --ink 700, always underlined (1px, offset .16em, 3px on hover), min-height var(--target), inline-flex. Its '↗' ::after is deleted.

.btn-lg, .cta, .cta-label and .cta-arrow are LEGACY until step 22 (.btn-lg equals .btn). SignIn.tsx's 'btn btn-lg' becomes 'btn'.

components.name: Links
components.spec:
There are three kinds, per owner decision 6.

(a) A link inside running text (p, li, dd, .prose, .lesson-body, .lesson-fine, .note, .stat-source, 404): --blue, underline 1px with max(1px, .0625rem) thickness at offset .16em. Hover is --blue-dark with a 3px underline. The fine-print variants (.lesson-fine, .stat-source, .note) inherit --muted and keep the underline.

(b) A row in a ruled list (.index-row, .lesson-row, .taxonomy-list a, search .r-title): --ink 700. The whole row is the link, and the title underlines on hover and focus.

(c) A standalone link (.crumb a, .tool-handoffs a, .taxonomy-all a, 'More about Business Lab', 'Next: <title>', .tool-jumps a): --ink 700, always underlined.

On the bar, links are white under .on-band. There is no visited colour and no arrow glyph in any link. External links keep rel='noopener noreferrer' and no target=_blank.

components.name: Crumb (.crumb, base.css; used by the track page, lesson, review and tool pages)
components.spec: One line, following owner decision 8. It is a p.crumb with display flex, flex-wrap, gap 0 12px, --text-sm and 16px below. The link is inline-flex, min-height var(--target), --ink 700 and underlined. Its text is the existing '← All tools' or '← All tracks', and on a lesson '← <track title>'. span.crumb-pos is --muted and tabular ('Lesson 1 of 4 · 10 min'). The page-scoped .crumb rules in the track, review and tool pages are deleted. This replaces v5's Breadcrumbs.astro, which is not built.

components.name: Inputs, labels, hints, notes and errors
components.spec:
Text, email, number and search inputs and textareas have a 2px solid --ink border, --radius, min-height var(--target-lg), padding 8px 12px, --text-md (at least 16px, so iOS never zooms), --bg and tabular-nums. Focus is a 3px --blue outline at offset 0; the border is unchanged. aria-invalid='true' gives a 2px --error border.

.field keeps the tool kit's order: label, hint, input, note, error. There is no markup change in tool-kit.tsx. The label is --text-md 700 --ink, .hint is --text-sm --muted, .field-note is --text-sm --ink-2, and .error is --text-sm 700 --error.

Number inputs are max-width 14em; text and email inputs are 100% up to 30em.

components.name: Select, radios and checkboxes
components.spec:
The select is the native control (appearance: auto). color-scheme light keeps its popup light on a dark OS. It uses the same box as inputs: 2px --ink border, --radius, 48px, --text-md, padding 0 36px 0 12px. There is no custom arrow and no customizable-select styling.

Radios and checkboxes are 24x24 with accent-color var(--ink), not blue (decision 6).

components.name: Disclosures (.fold in base.css, applied via :where() to .lesson-details, .practice-hint, .doc-hint, .tool details.how, .growth details, .week-table and details.lesson-steps-fold)
components.spec:
The summary is --ink 700, underlined, with min-height var(--target), preceded by a 7px CSS border triangle that points right, and down when open. The change is instant. The native marker is removed with list-style none and ::-webkit-details-marker.

The body has a 4px --rule border-inline-start and padding 16px 0 16px 20px, with no fill.

Practice hints keep 'Hint 1 of 3, the method' etc. They are free to open and several can be open at once. The '+' and '−' glyphs are deleted. Critical information never sits only in a fold.

The poll reveal, Show me steps and the header disclosures are not .fold: they have their own looks.

components.name: Table (.table; calculator year and amortisation tables; the dashboard table; the cookies tables)
components.spec:
width 100%, border-collapse collapse, --text-sm, --leading-ui. The caption is left-aligned, 700 and --text-md. thead th is 700 --ink with a 2px --ink bottom border and no fill. td has a 1px --rule bottom border and padding 12px 16px 12px 0; the last cell has no right padding. Cells are vertical-align top.

Numeric cells (.num, or the last column in tool tables) are right-aligned and tabular. th, td and code use overflow-wrap: anywhere. There are no stripes.

.table-wrap is overflow-x auto as a safety net only; tables are built not to overflow at 320. In print the head gets a 2px --print-ink rule.

components.name: Ledger (.ledger and its rows; EditionSum, Worked, ShowMe, calculator results, explorers)
components.spec:
The signature. Its structure is unchanged: label left, figure right, a 2px dotted --muted leader, a 1px --ink rule above a total, and a 3px double --ink rule under the final figure.

.ledger-figure moves from Bricolage to --font-body 700 at --text-lg; the total figure is --text-h2. .ledger-subtotal keeps a single 1px --ink rule and never the double. .ledger-note is --text-sm --muted on its own line. .is-loss stays --error, with words or a minus sign.

Rows keep flex-wrap, and the figure adds overflow-wrap: anywhere and white-space normal below 400px, so a figure such as ₹1,23,45,678 at 32px drops to its own line instead of overflowing (F14).

In Show me and .steps, rows have a 1px --rule between them and no box: the .steps box and its 1.5px navy border are removed.

components.name: Index list (.index-list, .index-row, .index-title, .index-sub, .index-meta, .index-flag)

Ruled rows: 1px --rule at the top of the list and under every row, 16px vertical padding. The row is one link with display grid. An optional leading column holds a 32x22 flag (.index-flag) or a number.

.index-title (h3 or span) is --text-lg 700 --ink, underlined on row hover and focus. .index-sub is --text-md --ink-2. .index-meta is --text-sm --muted and tabular. .index-go and its arrow are deleted.

The list is used for the home editions and starters and the tools index. The taxonomy lists use the same row look under their own class names, which are kept for the tests.

- span.lesson-num: --muted 700 tabular.
- span.lesson-title: --text-lg 700 --ink, or --text-md in compact; underlined on row hover.
- span.lesson-sub: --text-md --ink-2, full rows only.
- span.lesson-marks: --text-sm --muted with the minutes, and [data-mark='read'] ' · Read' and [data-mark='checks'] ' · Checks done' in --success 700, hidden until ProgressMarks reveals them.

Planned rows are muted plain text with '(being written)'. There are no circles, no connectors and no filled states. Step 22 deletes the old global .lesson-list and .course-* rules in lesson.css.

components.name: Poll (Poll.astro: the find-it question, practice, the three checks, drill situations; Review.tsx repeats the markup)

A framed question: 1px --border, --radius, white, padding 20px (24px from 640px), margin 32px 0, no fill.
- .poll-label is --text-sm --muted ('Question 1 of 3', 'Find it on the document').
- The legend is --text-lg 700 --ink, 12px below.
- .opts is a grid with an 8px gap. Each .opt label row is min-height 48px, padding 8px 16px, white, 1px --border, --radius, with a 24px radio. Hover sets the border to --ink. Checked (:has) gives a 2px --ink border (padding adjusted), a --tint fill and 700 --ink.
- The reveal summary is .btn .btn-secondary with the marker removed.
- .reveal-body has a 4px --rule border-inline-start and padding 16px 0 16px 20px.
- .poll-status is 700: 'Correct.' in --success, 'Not quite.' in --ink.

The @supports selector(:has(*)) feedback rules and the .fb and .answer markup are unchanged, so everything works with JS off.

components.name: Document (Document.astro)
components.spec:
A figure with a 1px --border, --radius, white, and 24px padding (16px at 360). The --paper and --brand-navy pinning goes.
- .doc-head: .doc-kind at --text-xs 700 --muted; .doc-title at --text-lg 700 --ink (Atkinson); .doc-note at --text-xs --muted.
- Lines are a grid of label and right-aligned 700 tabular value (minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, auto)) with a 1px dotted --border top rule.
- A hint summary is --ink with a 1px dotted --ink underline at offset 3px, 44px tall. The opened hint is --text-sm with a 4px --rule inline-start bar.
- .doc-task above it is --text-sm --muted.

components.name: Show me (ShowMe.astro, ShowMeStep.astro)

Each '.showme-more > summary' looks like .btn-secondary .btn-sm and reads 'Show line 2', with 'of 5' in --muted 400. The '+' ::before is deleted. Once open it becomes --text-sm --muted text ('Line 2 of 5'), with no border, and stays focusable.

.showme-caption is --text-md --ink-2 on its own line. 'Show every line' (.showme-all) is an ink 700 underlined text button. The key idea follows as p.key-idea.

The hooks .showme, .showme-line, '.showme-more > summary' with its texts, the nested details and the beforeprint open-all script are unchanged.

components.name: Video poster (Video.astro, VideoPlayer.tsx)

- Top-left at 16px: the title (--text-md 700 --ink) and the channel (--text-sm --muted).
- Centred: the Play button as the primary .btn. VideoPlayer.tsx's class becomes 'btn video-play', with the drawn triangle in currentColor and 'Play 4 min'. The gold pill and white border go.

- .ms-from is 700 --ink; .ms-amount is --text-h2 700 tabular (Atkinson).
- .ms-action has a 1px --border, --radius and a 700 --ink label.

components.name: Explorer (explorer.css; 'Change one thing')

.result-figure-value is --text-h1 700 ink tabular with overflow-wrap anywhere. .result-fact rows are --text-sm.

components.name: Boxes (.box, .box-surface)
components.spec:
.box is white with a 1px --rule, --radius, and 24px padding (16px at 360). .box-surface is the same on --surface.

They are allowed only where a box holds a figure or mixed content: the edition front's worked example, the results bench, the explorer, the five dashboard sections, the sign-in card and the consent dialog. The poll, document, mock screen and video frame are bordered instruments, not cards.

Deleted in step 22 after LEGACY: .card, .card-outline, .panel*, .sheet, .page-sheet, .grid-table, .pill*, .sticker*, .hand*, .doodle, .blobs, .grid-3, .cluster, .stack, .display, .hairline, .section-alt, .section-tight, .mega, .callout, .hl, .on-field, .section-dark, .course-*.

components.name: Notes and edition statistics
components.spec:
.note is --text-sm --muted under a 1px --rule with 16px padding-top; its links inherit and stay underlined.

ul.figures > li.stat is a ruled row (1px --rule top, 16px padding). From 768px it is a grid of 10em and 1fr: p.figure (--text-h2 700 ink tabular), then p.stat-label (--text-md) and p.stat-source ('Source: ' plus an underlined link, --text-xs --muted).

Every figure carries its sentence and its source, so this is not a stat banner, and it is never three big numbers across.

components.name: Charts (savings growth, dashboard week, the ring, lesson SVGs)
components.spec:
Series colours in fixed order, light values only. Axes and grid use --chart-grid. Labels are --text-xs in --ink-2; strong labels are --ink 700 with a --bg halo stroke. Every chart has direct labels and a data table.

Week bars use rx 2. Today is marked by a 2px --ink stroke and the word 'Today', not by colour. The ring has a --chart-grid track, a --series-1 done arc and butt caps.

No dual axis, no gradient, no animation.

components.name: Logo (Logo.astro) and brand mark (scripts/brand-mark.mjs)

- Default is the drawing unchanged: a #0C61C4 disc, a 1.5px white ring and a white B. It is used in the footer at 32px on white (the disc is 5.96:1 against white).
- Inverse is a #FFFFFF disc with a #0C61C4 ring and B. It is used in the header at 32px on the bar: the disc is 8.35:1 against #0B4AA2 and the B is 5.96:1 on the disc.

The raw hex stays here, the one allowed place besides Flag.astro. scripts/brand-mark.mjs adds badgeInverse(), drawing the same thing for the share images. The favicon, logo-mark.svg and the app icons keep the default badge. The maskable icon's navy field (#0B1240, the ink) is 3.0:1 against the disc and is unchanged, so brand-icons.mjs is not re-run.

components.name: Footer (Footer.astro)
components.spec:

The grid is one column at 360, two from 640 (the brand block across both), and four from 1024 (2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr, 48px gap).
- The brand block: default Logo at 32px, a 12px gap, the wordmark in Atkinson 700 at --text-lg --ink, and the blurb at --text-sm --muted (max 36ch).
- The headings 'Editions', 'Site' and 'Legal' are h2 at --text-sm 700 --ink.
- Links are --text-sm --ink-2 with no underline until hover, in rows of min-height var(--target) (44px, so /accessibility's target sentence holds). The current edition row is 700 --ink.
- 'Privacy choices' stays button.linklike[data-open-consent].
- The base row, under a 1px --rule: 'For learning only. Not financial, legal, or tax advice.' and '© <year> Rajvir Dixit. Text is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; code is MIT.' at --text-xs --muted.

The copy is unchanged, including 'Tools'.

components.name: Focus ring and skip link

problems: P4 and the reviser's 'no step edits an existing assertion' are false. tests/e2e/a11y.spec.ts:96-122 ('a sticky header fits inside the scroll padding') asserts `if (width >= 1280) expect(stuckAnywhere, 'the header is sticky on a wide screen').toBe(true)`. Once step 5 makes the header static, this test fails in gate G at step 5 and every step after it.

The LEGACY migration causes a real 2.4.11 failure and fails gate G in steps 2 to 4. Step 2 maps --header-h to 0px, but the old Header.astro stays sticky from 1040px until step 5. Its .header-inner min-height becomes 0, so the header is about 68px (12+44+12). base.css scroll-padding-top becomes calc(0px + 32px) = 32px in step 2 and 24px in step 4. The a11y test requires h <= pad - 8, so it fails at 1040 and 1280. In use, jump targets and focused elements scroll under a 68px sticky header, and the tools bench (tools.css:20, top: calc(var(--header-h) + 16px) = 16px) and the dashboard side nav (dashboard.css:7) slide under it.

The fixed consent banner hides the end of the page from keyboard focus. That is a 2.4.11 failure, and it breaks P2 and the new /accessibility claim 'Nothing fixed on the screen hides the focused element'. scroll-padding-bottom only affects where an element scrolls into view; it cannot scroll past the end of the document. At maximum scroll, the last 245px (1024 and up) to 413px (320 wide) of the page stays under the bar. That region holds the footer's last Legal and Site rows (Terms, Accessibility, Disclaimer, 'Privacy choices') and the base row. P2's own 40-stop Tab walk on in/tools/break-even at 1280x720 reaches about 42 stops, lands on those rows and fails. consent.spec.ts already notes 'The first-visit banner sits over the footer'.

P3 measures --banner-reserve at the wrong widths. With v5.1 metrics (Atkinson, 16px text, 16px gutter, the h2 at --text-md, 44px .btn-sm row) the measured banner heights are: 413px (25.8rem) at 320, 316px (19.7rem) at 360 and 390, 292px at 414, and 244-245px from 640 to 1280, where the paragraph is capped at 32em. P3 measures at 360x800, 768x1024 and 1280x720, which gives about 20rem for the band below 640px. At 320x640 (fixed, because 640 >= 561) the banner starts at y 227 while the scroll-padding safe region runs to y 320. Controls between y 227 and 320 are neither scrolled nor visible. The spec's own 'about 25rem' figure matches 320, not the 360 it says to measure at.

The P2 design.spec Tab-walk cannot pass as written. It asserts that every focused rect.top is above the banner's rect.top, but the walk eventually focuses the banner's own buttons (Reject all, Accept all, Choose), whose top is always below the banner's top. The check also runs only at 360x800 and 1280x720, not at 320x640, where the reserve is short.

The table rule 'cells wrap, so the table never scrolls sideways at 320' works by breaking money figures in the middle. The loan table (LoanEmi.tsx:71-77) has four columns. With #principal=123456789, each money cell such as '₹13,87,52,300' measures 106px at 16px, so Year plus three money columns plus 16px padding need about 406px in a 288px column. With overflow-wrap: anywhere on td, Chromium splits them into fragments such as '₹13,87,5' / '2,300', which read as two numbers on a money-teaching site. The same guard on .result-figure-value, .explorer-figure and .figure splits long figures at a random digit instead of at a group separator. WCAG 1.4.10 already exempts data tables.

The disclosure script's rule 'focusout closes it when relatedTarget is outside it' loses clicks in Safari and in Firefox on macOS. In both, clicking a link does not focus it, so focus falls to body and relatedTarget is null, which the rule treats as outside. If focus was inside the menu (opened by keyboard, or a VoiceOver or Switch Control user), the details closes on mousedown, the link stops rendering, and the click never navigates. Both Playwright projects are Chromium (playwright.config.ts: 'Pixel 5' and 'Desktop Chrome'), and Chromium focuses links on click, so no test catches this.
